_meta.purpose: Bohemian persona + ethereal/grounded axis.  Tone/framing axis: mystical/abstract vs concrete/practical.  Bohemian is the first base-persona candidate (|μ|=1.00, n=4).  Question mix: 5 ethereal-trait abstract-experience prompts + 5 grounded-trait practical-advice prompts + 2 bohemian-role lifestyle probes + 1 extraction power + 1 hand-written.
